page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 virtual CPUs, mapped from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not included, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations reveal a distinct performance profile characterized by moderate multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The instance achieves average ratings in multi-core processing, as evidenced by its stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores. However, single-core performance is limited, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth is generally average for both small cached and large uncached read operations, though the overall Passmark memory score remains in the lower quartile.

Given its hardware configuration and performance characteristics, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is suited for workloads that can effectively parallelize tasks across its 32 vCPUs. Appropriate applications include multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and database operations, where it demonstrates average throughput. It is also capable of handling moderate LLM inference tasks for smaller models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced resource density of compute and memory for general-purpose enterprise applications, though workloads highly dependent on single-threaded performance or local high-speed storage may find it less optimal.

Network performance is anchored by a 15 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Benchmarks indicate average multi-core processing capabilities, software compilation speeds, and static web serving throughput, contrasted by weak single-core performance and lower single-threaded compression efficiency. This resource profile makes the instance suitable for parallelized workloads, multi-threaded applications, database operations, and general-purpose enterprise tasks that do not require high single-threaded speed or local SSD storage.
